notes:
CRM notes / call snippets:
- Prospect: Cerulean DataWorks (mid-large fintech, customer data + transaction metadata).
- Primary ask: private VPC deployment with keys customer-managed (BYOK) and HSM-backed assurance for signing. Needs: AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS compatibility; if possible HSM attestation support.
- Quote from CISO: "We cannot hand over key control — must retain root of trust." Wants explicit key rotation and export controls.
- Infosec pushed on audit trail: need per-request audit logging, immutable logs forwarded to their Splunk instance for 7+ years.
- Engineering note: latency budget tight for reranking (p95 inference < 120ms). Will accept small tradeoff for envelope encryption.
- Commercial: procurement expects three vendor comparisons; pricing sensitivity moderate — willing to pay premium for HSM-backed private deployment.
- PoC scope agreed: 2-week BYOK PoC with AWS KMS CMKs, a vault in Azure Key Vault for a subset of traffic, and verification of audit log integration.
- Action items: SE to provide KMS integration checklist, Arch diagram for dataplane and key lifecycle, security answers doc, and updated SOW.
- Internal: tag as high priority enterprise opp; push to dedicated/private engineering backlog for feasibility checks.
technical_requirements: Summary of KMS/HSM needs: support for AWS KMS (CMK & Envelope encryption), Azure Key Vault with Managed HSM, GCP KMS; BYOK flow (importable key material and external HSM attestation preferred); key rotation schedules, automated rewrap/reencryption for cached KV; per-request audit metadata (key-id, key-version, requestor, timestamp) surfaced to customer audit pipeline; KMS policies to support split-ownership (Cerulean controls master keys, Redwood manages operational keys); optional HSM signing for model artifacts. Need clear docs for KMS IAM roles, cross-account key grants, and emergency key rotation playbook.
risk_assessment: Medium-high. Risks: legal wants proof of non-exfiltration of key material; potential latency/regression from envelope encryption; integration effort to forward audit logs to customer Splunk with retention policy. Mitigations: run BYOK PoC, provide signed attestation from HSM provider, bench latency with sample workload, propose staged rollout (canary -> full).
commercial_notes: Pricing ask: 12-month committed Dedicated + Private control plane add-on. Finance will review with discounts tiered based on committed throughput. Expect SOW revision after PoC. Procurement contact is VP Finance (name provided on 2026-02-18 email).
eng_gist: SE checklist requested: 1) exact KMS provider endpoints + permissions, 2) network egress rules for private VPC, 3) audit log shipping config, 4) HSM attestation steps, 5) fallback model variant (non-HSM) for emergency degradation.
customer_quotes: We need absolute control over master keys — nothing escrowed.
If we can't get HSM attestation we won't sign an enterprise deal.
Latency p95 target is 120ms for reranking; can trade some cost for lower latency where needed.
